flags.message: The September 16 snapshot records an opposition submitted September 14 and a supplemental brief filed June 16, but the provisioned document manifest contains only the petition and QP extraction, fetched July 17. The forecast therefore lacks both briefs' substance; the missing opposition is material to whether Jules warrants a GVR. This is unavailable text, not an absent response.

Retrieved separate companion precedent Jules v. Andre Balazs Properties, No. 25-83, decided May 14, 2026, through CourtListener opinion 11326163. Its retained-jurisdiction reasoning materially increases the GVR forecast. It predates this forward cell's September 16 snapshot; no disposition of this petition was sought or encountered.
